title: Sensor Config Parser: string_view + optional
hints: split: loop with `std::size_t pos = s.find(delim)`; push `s.substr(0, pos)` and `s.remove_prefix(pos + 1)`. Remember the last token after the final delimiter.
trim: `find_first_not_of(" \t")` / `find_last_not_of`; return an empty view if all whitespace. No allocation.
parseDouble: `auto [ptr, ec] = std::from_chars(s.data(), s.data() + s.size(), out);` succeed only if `ec == std::errc()` and `ptr == s.data() + s.size()`.
parseSensor: keep a `std::optional<...>` per field; a duplicate key means that optional is already engaged → nullopt. At the end, all four must be engaged.
